hub.title: Finance
hub.noAccessDescription: Finance is available to Finance, Executive and Admin roles.
hub.bucketHelp: How this age balance is calculated
hub.receivablesHint: Sum of known outstanding balances on open invoices, including tax. Draft and cancelled invoices are excluded.
hub.payablesHint: Unpaid supplier invoice balances (invoice amount less payments made), grouped by currency. Unknown balances are counted, not added.
hub.reportsHint: Earned revenue minus invoiced revenue through the latest selected month, before tax.
hub.statementsHint: Net profit from the latest available company profit and loss statement period.
hub.receivableBucketHint: Known outstanding balances grouped by days past due. Not yet due includes balances due today or later.
hub.payableBucketHint: Known unpaid supplier balances grouped by calendar days since the invoice was recorded. Invoices with an unknown balance are counted in their age group, not added.
hub.finding: {{overdue}} overdue across {{count}} invoices{{oldest}} · {{payables}} to pay suppliers
hub.overdueHint: Count of open invoices past their derived due date; total sums known outstanding balances, including tax, by currency.
hub.invoiceBalanceHint: Known ERP outstanding amount in the invoice currency, including tax.
hub.draftsApproveHint: Count of draft invoices that you can approve.
hub.draftsSecondHint: Count of your draft invoices that need another approver.
hub.notReceivedHint: Count of active invoices with no received date recorded.
hub.unappliedHint: Count and known unapplied amounts for active receipts.
hub.waitingPayablesHint: Count, total amount and age of supplier invoices recorded and still waiting to be paid.
hub.payablesDescription: Supplier invoices waiting to be paid.
hub.oldestPayableHint: Calendar days since the supplier invoice was recorded, using the oldest payable invoice.
hub.noPayables: No supplier invoices waiting to be paid.
hub.payablesTable: Supplier invoices waiting to be paid

figures.title: Report figures
figures.earnedNotInvoicedHelp: Earned to date minus invoiced to date, using the report’s revenue recognition basis.
figures.earnedToDateHelp: Cumulative recognized revenue through the as-at month; the subline shows this month’s change.
figures.invoicedToDateHelp: Cumulative dated invoice value and invoice count through the as-at month.
figures.backlogHelp: Contract total minus revenue earned to date; unavailable if a foreign-currency invoice needs reconciliation.

managementPack.noProgressNote: No progress is recorded yet, so earned revenue follows what has been invoiced.
